labels: The student's shoulders and face are turned diagonally between frontal and full profile, leaving both eyes visible with one cheek narrower in perspective.; 학생의 어깨와 얼굴이 정면과 완전 측면 사이 대각으로 돌아 두 눈이 보이고 한쪽 볼이 원근상 좁아진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The student's shoulders and face are turned diagonally between frontal and full profile, leaving both eyes visible with one cheek narrower in perspective.
aliases: 인물 삼사면 회전
